codex.norse.name: Norse Codex
codex.norse.description: The permanent founding Codex of Rune Scribe, presented with weathered stone, carved dark wood, forged iron, restrained bronze, and the Base Rune Script.

relics.relic.norse.runestone-tablet: A broad carved runestone tablet with a dimensional iron-and-knotwork border and round raven crest.
relics.relic.norse.dragonwood-plaque: A tall dark carved-wood plaque with forged iron fittings and a sculpted dragon crown.
relics.relic.norse.stormforged-stele: A tall weathered war-stele with blackened iron fittings and a carved hammer crest.

seals.seal.norse.valknut: An aged bronze medallion bearing a sculpted interlocked Valknut.
seals.seal.norse.ravenshield: A forged shield medallion bearing a sculpted raven.
seals.seal.norse.mjolnir: A relief medallion bearing the hammer Mjolnir.
seals.seal.norse.wolkin: An aged medallion bearing a sculpted wolf beneath the northern sky.
seals.seal.norse.yggdrasil: A sculpted medallion bearing the world tree Yggdrasil.
seals.seal.norse.berserk: A dark forged medallion bearing a battle-worn warrior mark.

frame.frame.norse.carved-knotwork: A carved silver-and-gold mastery frame with sculpted knotwork corner ornaments.

crest.crest.norse.raven-mastery: A weathered shield crest bearing a sculpted silver raven and restrained blue enamel.

background.background.norse.cold-sea-hall: A cold northern sea, distant longship and fjord settlement, and an ancient timber hall under deep navy light.

title.title.norse.master-of-runes: Master of Runes, the Norse Codex mastery title.

policies.decorativeRunicHeadings: Hide the decorative runic heading from VoiceOver when the adjacent localized subtitle already names the destination.
policies.lockedState: Never communicate locked, selected, owned, encountered, or unavailable state by color alone.
policies.reduceMotion: Replace tracing, assembly, particle, and scale animations with short crossfades and static highlights.
policies.dynamicType: User-facing labels, requirements, and security summaries use Dynamic Type. Decorative glyph artwork may scale within bounded safe regions but cannot replace readable labels.
policies.sound: Unlock sounds are optional, respect silent mode and volume, and have an independent Setting.
policies.haptics: Haptics are supplemental only and never the sole indication of completion.
